issues.on_page: Reclassifications column p6: Support services - Instruction (1,473,679), General administration (7,763,016), Central services (6,939,464), Operation and maintenance of plant (9,225,010)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: contra split into support services -1,473,679, General Administration -7,763,016, Business -6,939,464, Building and Grounds -9,225,010] The contra line puts four eliminations into one category. The gross General Fund lines they offset are in General Administration (2310-2330), Business (2510-2590) and Building and Grounds (2610-2660), and on the statement 'Staff' is Instruction under the LPS ruling. So support services is understated and those other categories are overstated by the same amounts. The contra should be split by category: Instruction or support services 1,473,679, General Administration 7,763,016, Business 6,939,464, Building and Grounds 9,225,010
